description: Source code for generating cryptographically secure random bytes, including platform-specific entropy collection, initialization, reseeding, and cleanup routines, used in the lighttpd web server project.

methods.name: li_getentropy
methods.description: Collects cryptographically secure entropy from platform-specific sources, such as getentropy, getrandom, or Windows rand_s.

methods.name: li_rand_device_bytes
methods.description: Attempts to gather random bytes from device files like /dev/urandom or /dev/random, or via platform-specific system calls.

methods.name: li_rand_init
methods.description: Initializes and seeds various cryptographic random number generators based on available platform-specific APIs and libraries.

methods.name: li_rand_reseed
methods.description: Re-seeds the PRNGs, refreshing entropy from platform sources or cryptographic libraries.

methods.name: li_rand_pseudo
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random integer using available cryptographic or system-based RNGs, not suitable for cryptographic purposes.

methods.name: li_rand_pseudo_bytes
methods.description: Fills a buffer with pseudo-random bytes, attempting to use cryptographically strong sources if available.

methods.name: li_rand_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and releases resources associated with cryptographic RNGs.
